ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Certreq Command to Download
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a suspicious certreq execution taken from the LOLBAS examples, which can be abused to download (small) files

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\certreq\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "CertReq\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-Post\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-config\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ http.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ C\\:\\\\windows\\\\win\\\.ini\\ .*")))
